articleTitle: Design of Pose measurement and Display system based on STM32 and MPU6050
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In recent years, graphical programming language and embedded technology have developed gradually, and have been more and more applied in various fields. 3D model making and display are no exception. However, in the model demonstration program, software and hardware are often two independent individuals, and there is no effective and convenient linkage for users. This paper designs a 3D model display system which can link software and hardware, through the data communication and data processing between STM32 and LabVIEW, so that users can use the external sensor of STM32 to control the motion of 3D model.

articleTitle: Semi-automatic marking system for robot competition based on PyQT5
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In RoboCup kid-size group competition, it’s necessary to label field information, but the debugging time for each team before the competition is limited. In addition, a certain amount of time needs to be set aside for model training, which leads to the time of field labeling is not enough. Most teams use manual labeling tools to label the game field information, which is often inefficient and takes a lot of time. This paper aims to reduce the time required for field information labeling before the competition. We present a semi-automatic labeling system for robot competitions, which provides manual and semi-automatic labeling methods. The client interface is designed by PyQT5 framework, which cooperates with the back-end SiamRPN algorithm to provide a semi-automatic labeling function. In order to decouple the client interface and the back-end algorithm, the RPyC framework is used to connect the front and back-end calling interfaces. After testing, the labeling speed of RoboCup competition field in the system is greatly improved and the debugging time for other robot modules is more abundant.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional Leakage Magnetic Field Simulation and Short-circuit Impedance Calculation of Large Yoke Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Limited by road and railway transportation conditions, the volume of large transformers cannot be increased indefinitely. For this reason, it is necessary to compress the height of the transformer core for transportation. However, the change of the core size will cause problems such as uneven distribution of the leakage magnetic field, excessive loss of the leakage magnetic field, and changes in the short-circuit impedance. Based on Magnet software, a three-dimensional transient field simulation analysis of the short-circuit performance of a 500kV single-phase three-column yoke transformer was carried out in this paper, and the leakage magnetic field and winding short-circuit impedance of the yoke transformer were obtained. The simulation results were compared with the experimental values provided by the manufacturer, showing small error, which verified the simulation method, and provided theoretical guidance for transformer design in the actual engineering.

articleTitle: LCornerIoU: An Improved IoU-based Loss Function for Accurate Bounding Box Regression
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Bounding box regression is an important step in the process of object detection, which has a direct impact on the accuracy of model location. The $\ell_{n}$ loss is widely used in bounding box regression, but the criterion of locational accuracy is Intersection over Union (IOU), and there is no strong correlation between them. Although IoU-based loss functions have been proposed successively, such as IoU, GIoU, DIoU and CIoU, which make location loss directly related to evaluation criteria, there are still problems such as slow training convergence speed and inaccurate model location. Based on the IoU loss function, we add normalized corner distance and parameterized width height difference to form a new loss function: LCornerIoU loss. The results of bounding box regression simulation show that LCornerIoU loss is superior to other IoU-based loss functions in terms of convergence speed and positioning accuracy. Experiments on COCO benchmark show that the performance of the Faster R-CNN, RetinaNet, and YOLO-v5s models combined with LCornerIoU loss have consistent performance improvement compared with IoU loss.

articleTitle: System design of picking robot based on computer vision
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Picking robots are widely used in the harvesting of various agricultural products, which can significantly reduce the labor cost in agricultural production and solve the problem of labor shortage in agricultural production. Computer vision technology can identify ripe melons and fruits from their natural growth environment, which is the key for picking robot to achieve target positioning and coordinate manipulator. In this paper, the method of designing robot picking experiment platform based on computer vision is proposed, and intelligent picking is realized by constructing robot picking experiment platform. The experimental results show that the robot picking experimental platform based on computer vision can solve the problem of low picking efficiency of the previous platform, and can realize the efficient picking of different fruits and melons, which provides a research basis for the picking robot to better meet the actual demand of agricultural production.

articleTitle: Task scheduling considering multiple constraints in mobile edge computing
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: With the development of the Internet of Things (IoT) technology, a large amount of data generated by IoT devices is difficult to process. As a feasible solution, mobile edge computing solves the problem of insufficient computing power by deploying edge servers near IoT devices. When the edge server receives the tasks uploaded by the IoT device, it needs to calculate these tasks in a certain order. However, there are a variety of constraint relationships between tasks. How to arrange the calculation sequence of tasks based on these relationships to reduce the time to complete all tasks has become a difficult problem. This paper comprehensively considers the three relationships between tasks, and proposes a heuristic task scheduling method based on the idea of differential evolution. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can obtain a task sequencing scheme with lower completion time and faster convergence.

articleTitle: Design and Experimental Research on Flexible Capacitive Tactile Sensor Based on Micro-Electro-Mechanical-System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: With the increasing degree of social automation, various type of sensors play important roles in many fields, such as aerospace, robotics, medicine and biology, etc. Based on this, a capacitive flexible tactile sensor for pressure detection of robot hand is designed in this project. A sensor array with an area of 24mm*24mm 4*4 was fabricated by using micro-electro-mechanical-system technology. Through the finite element simulation analysis and experimental verification of the designed sensor, the results show that the sensitivity of the sensor is 23.75% / N, the range is 6N, the linear error is 9.09%, and the maximum error is 1.30%. The test results of response time and rebound time are 0.1s and 0.3s respectively. The device has reliable overall structure, full flexibility and excellent performance.

articleTitle: A Novel Elite Information Interaction Based Differential Evolution
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Meta-heuristic algorithms (MHAs) have emerged in recent years to handle optimization difficulties. Due to the limitations of these algorithms, the improvement of MHAs has become a research hotspot. As one of the most representative and powerful MHA, differential evolution (DE) has become our improvement object. In this study, we improved the parent individual selection mechanism in DE mutation operation and proposed a novel elite information interaction-based differential evolution (EDE). According to the experimental results of IEEE CEC2017 benchmark functions, EDE demonstrates its superior performance.

articleTitle: Research on robot dexterous grasping for aerospace product parts
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Aerospace products have different dimensions and topological structures. Traditional robot manipulators are not flexible enough to meet the requirements of complex tasks. It is also impossible to use existing operating tools. Therefore, it is necessary to operate various parts and tools with humanoid dexterous hands. This paper first analyzes the basic characteristics of manual operation and gives the basic method of finger planning. Then the kinematics analysis of a humanoid five-finger dexterous hand is carried out. Finally, a dexterous grasping experiment is carried out for some aerospace product parts.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Firefighter Signs Monitoring System Based on Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: With the development of economy, there are more and more buildings and cities are getting more and more crowded, which brings great challenges to firefighting and rescue. While performing search and rescue tasks, firefighters are unable to evacuate accident scenes in time due to factors such as excessive fatigue and dangerous situations, resulting in a great threat to firefighters’ personal safety. Relying on modern high-tech rescue equipment can effectively reduce casualties, so it is very urgent to develop a reliable and safe vital signs monitoring system. Based on the above background, this paper researches and designs a set of vital signs monitoring system for firefighters. The core of the system is a multi-functional wrist watch, with a waist relay module as the information relay component, which can record the firefighter’s heart rate, body temperature, walking steps, air pressure height, compass and Compass positioning in real time and transmit them to the background through Lora communication technology, so that the whole system can monitor the firefighter’s body signs at all times.

articleTitle: Stability analysis of bi-directional DC-DC converter based on battery energy storage
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: For regenerative braking energy utilization in 2300V drive system of large Scale Tramcar, a bidirectional DC-DC converter with input H-bridge form of parallel interleaving + LCL filtering based on lithium battery energy storage device is studied. the H-bridge can effectively reduce the voltage stress of IGBT, reactor and filter capacitor, the parallel interleaved topology can reduce the output current ripple, and the LCL filter circuit can further reduce the output current ripple under the same reactor capacity. This paper firstly discussesed the topology and control strategy of the bidirectional DC-DC converter designed under the actual operating conditions of this large mining vehicle, and finally verified the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy by modeling and analyzing the stability of this bidirectional DC-DC system.

articleTitle: Improved K-means Algorithm for Construction of Adjustable Potential Resource Pool
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: As the large amount of renewable energy, energy storage system, flexible load and other multi-adjustable resource being accessed to the distribution network, it is necessary to study on the aggregation algorithm for adjustable potential of multi-adjustable resource in distribution network to make them fully utilized to satisfy the detailed requirements of big data in power system, and increase the operation efficiency of distribution network. The paper firstly put forward ADPC-kmeans(Automatically Density Peak Clustering-kmeans) algorithm based on K-means and DPC (Density Peak Clustering) aggregation algorithm. The paper then clusters and aggregates the adjustable resource based on a large quantity of history data. Next, the paper proposes a method to construct an adjustable potential resource pool in different time scales. The result of MATLAB simulation suggests that the algorithm and method proposed in the paper could clearly classify the type of adjustable resource, and makes all kinds of adjustable resource appropriately aggregate together and dispatch as well as adjust successively. The algorithm and method could provide skill support for new energy consumption, optimal scheduling of distribution network, demand side response, emergency cooperative control, ancillary services and other kinds of business.

articleTitle: Equipment Anomaly Detection in Power Grids Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: With the rapid development of smart grids, intelligent inspection play an increasingly important role as a key part of smart grid construction, with the generation of a large amount of image data. How to establish an automated and efficient mechanism for detecting device anomalies on these big data is the focus of this paper. First, mask region-based convolutional neural networks (Mask R-CNN) is used in visible light images for equipment segmentation to detect all the equipment which need to be tested. Second, the temperature of these equipment are extracted from the corresponding infrared images. Then, different machine learning methods are used to classify anomaly and normal equipment. Testing results showed that Mask R-CNN can detect various electrical devices of different categories in one image simultaneously within 80 milliseconds and achieve the mean average precision (mAP) of 94.82% on a standard test set, which is of great significance in real-time power transmission line inspection. This equipment anomaly detection method combining visible light and infrared images not only refines the range of feature extraction, which reduce the noise of extracting features from the entire image and improve the classification accuracy, but also locates the anomaly equipment precisely in the image.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic power prediction model based on empirical mode decomposition-long-short memory neural network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The permeability of photovoltaic power supply in the power grid is constantly improving. Accurate short-term photovoltaic power generation prediction is conducive to ensuring the safe and stable operation of the power grid connected with high-ratio photovoltaic power supply. It is necessary to further improve the prediction accuracy of photovoltaic power in the process of power development. Photovoltaic output power will be affected by weather conditions and seasons, and it is easy to change with external factors, showing volatility. Therefore, with the introduction of a variety of influencing factors and increasing reference data, accurate and efficient short-term photovoltaic power generation prediction is conducive to ensuring the safe and stable operation of the power grid connected with high-ratio photovoltaic power supply. In order to further improve the prediction accuracy of photovoltaic power generation, this paper adopts a short-term rolling prediction method of photovoltaic power based on empirical mode decomposition and deep learning. A photovoltaic power prediction model combining empirical mode decomposition with long-term and short-term memory networks is proposed. The error comparison between BP, SVM and LSTM models and EMDLSTM model shows that EMD-LSTM has the highest prediction accuracy. The results can further improve the accuracy of photovoltaic power prediction.

Author Keywords: Long and short term memory neural network

articleTitle: External Forces/Torques Perception of Robot Endeffector Tip Based on a 6-axis Force Sensor
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In this paper, an automatic identification program of force perception parameters (including gravity and centroid of the end-effector, the installation angels of the manipulator) is developed with the use of a 6-axis force/torque sensor. Then the identified parameters are used in forces/torques sensor data processing algorithm, which consists of filtering and zeroing, gravity compensation, coordinate transformation, and dead zone process, to obtain accurate external forces/torques information on end-effector tip. The experiments for testing the accuracy of parameters identification and the dynamic performance of force perception are carried out.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis of the MIMU Random-Drift Error Based on Wavelet Soft-threshold and ARIMA Model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In the paper, the low-frequency part of the random-drift error on micro inertial measurement unit (MIMU) is modeled. In order to solve the problem of high-frequency interference and ensure the original correlation of the samples, the wavelet soft-threshold method is used to remove high-frequency noise and the autoregressive integrated moving average model (ARIMA), which is more complex than the first-order Markov, is used to describe the slow-drift of the random-drift error. Finally, the model is applied to Kalman filter to smooth, filter and predict the MIMU measurement data. The experimental results show that the model has good dynamic tracking performance, the model better reflects the drift process of MIMU random error, and improves the measurement accuracy of micro-inertial devices.

articleTitle: Study on Performance Modification of Insulation Wraps for Power Transmission Line Corona Noise Prevention
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Study and prevention of transmission line corona noise has become an important means to effectively promote the environmental friendliness and energy saving of transmission line. Studies have shown that using hydrophilic coating treatment on the conductor surface, so that under the condition of precipitation, the rainwater can be evenly distributed on the conductor surface to reduce the formation density of water droplets, which can weaken the impact of raindrops on the curvature radius of the conductor. As a result, less distorted electric field and soft noise were produced, leading to reduce corona noise ultimately. The greater hydrophilicity of the conductor surface, the more significant the reduction of corona noise is. In this paper, experiments have validated that the modification of nano aluminum oxide by electron beam radiation graft technology can improve its surface reactivity, promote its dispersion and bonding ability in RTV rubber matrix, and then elevate the hydrophobicity, mechanical properties and aging resistance of modified RTV silicone rubber. In addition, specific properties of thermal conductivity and hydrophobicity can be improved by further adding functional monomers.

articleTitle: Research on PMSM Sensorless Control Based on Improved Synovial Observer Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The synovial observer algorithm is widely used in practical production because it does not require high system accuracy and is insensitive to external changes. The traditional synovial observer algorithm will cause the system chattering. Therefore, an improved synovial observer algorithm is proposed, specifically: 1. The Tanx function is introduced to replace the symbolic function; 2. An inverse observer is introduced to obtain the back EMF; 3. PLL is introduced to replace Arctanx function. In this paper, the PMSM sensorless control block diagram based on the improved sliding film observer algorithm is constructed, and the motor speed, position and back EMF are studied. The model simulation is carried out on the MATLAB/Simulink platform to verify that the improved sliding film observer algorithm can achieve the rotor position and speed tracking effect, and has a good system chattering suppression effect, which can meet the actual production requirements.

articleTitle: Research on Forest Fire Detection Algorithm Based on Yolov5
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: An important mean of early forest fire warning is observation of the scene by the fire prevention center around the clock. Traditional monitoring techniques include manual observation, dedicated patrols and satellite detection. With the rapid development of computer vision technology, image identification has been widely used in fields like agriculture, medical treatment, environmental protection, etc. This article mainly uses image identification technology to detect the smoke and flame produced by forest fire. By analyzing the pictures taken by the camera of the drone, the relevant features of smoke and flame areas are extracted for fire recognition and location.

articleTitle: Data Sharing among the Dual DSPs and Multi-SRIO Devices Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In this paper, we pursue a solution for data sharing via SRIO interface in the embedded system with dual DSPs. In order to collect the information of the other devices in the system and control them, the two DSPs create a fast and reliable link based on SRIO to access the system respectively. In this context, DSP not only achieve the purpose of coordinated control, but also monitor each other under some special conditions. Finally, we complete the design and implementation based on FPGA.

articleTitle: Research on high-latitude transfer alignment technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The Arctic Circle is rich in resources and has huge economic potential. Since the 21st century, its strategic position has become increasingly prominent. The development and utilization of the polar region has become the focus of attention of all countries. The transfer alignment of the polar high latitude sea area is a comprehensive technology, which mainly involves three technical issues: shipborne inertial navigation polar area navigation technology, shipborne inertial navigation mode switching technology, high latitude moving base transfer alignment matching Technology. Solving the transfer alignment of missile-ships in high-latitude seas in polar regions will greatly improve the adaptability of my country’s underwater vehicles in the Arctic. Inertial navigation system transfer alignment technology and other key technologies are focused on research. Aiming at the problems of complicated navigation parameter conversion in the polar navigation application of inertial navigation system of the existing lateral coordinate system and difficulty in information cross-linking between different navigation systems, a new method based on The grid unified the transfer alignment method of the polar earth ellipsoid model, and the grid transfer alignment was simulated and verified. The simulation showed that the transfer alignment algorithm is correct, the content is comprehensive, and the verification of key technical approaches is feasible.

articleTitle: A Review of Bad Smells in Cloud-based Applications and Microservices
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Cloud- and Microservice-based applications are continuously gaining attention in the field of practical software engineering as well as in academic research, but the bad practices exist in such applications have not yet been systematically discussed and analyzed. Moreover, the impact of bad practices to actual systems and code quality indicators, e.g. reliability, testability, maintainability, are remaining unknown, making systematic review an important task to fulfill. The author uses Code Smell, i.e. the sub-optimal implementation and design choices, as an aspect to analyze empirically the bad practice of Cloud and Microservice based applications. This paper investigated 33 infrastructure configuration smells and 34 microservice smells through a Systematic Literature Review (SLR), and provided 2 appendixes concerning the above-mentioned 2 kinds of smells. Additionally, this paper also predicts the future development of this field according to actual works done and the gaps to be filled. Future research in related area can rely on this paper as a reference.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation Analysis of Energy Storage STATCOM Based on S-Function
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: With the development and utilization of new energy and the development of energy storage technology, a new type of power quality compensation device combined with energy storage technology has become a new research direction. This paper proposes a new type of energy storage STATCOM, a three-phase H-bridge inverter circuit topology with a two-way DC/DC conversion circuit in series with a super capacitor energy storage module on the DC side. In the MATLAB/Simulink environment, a system simulation model of the energy storage STATCOM based on S-Function was built. The most critical control algorithm was implemented by the S-Function module based on C language programming. Finally, a simulation study of the entire system is carried out. The simulation results show that the system can maintain the stability of the DC bus voltage and has a good reactive power compensation effect, which verifies the effectiveness of the control algorithm implemented by the S-Function module.

articleTitle: Benign and malignant classification of pulmonary nodules based on multi-level feature fusion
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Lung nodules are incipient manifestations of lung cancer, and lung nodules detection and benign/malignant classification based on CT images are of great clinical significance. Aiming at overcoming the difficulty of benign/malignant classification of lung nodules in clinical practice, we put forward a benign or malignant classification algorithm on the strength of multi-level feature fusion. Our method can not only fuse the context features at different levels, but also performs benign or malignant classification at different levels, and the final classification result is obtained by voting. Experiments on LUNA16, a public dataset of chest CT images, show that our method is very effective.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Financial Risk Platform Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The rapid development and mature application of mobile Internet technologies such as big data, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and blockchain have provided a strong impetus for the integration of technology and finance and promoted the innovation and reform of financial management models. At the same time, in the face of increasingly complex financial market environments, traditional financial risk management, and early warning methods are becoming more and more passive and backward, facing unprecedented challenges in business management models, new technology application capabilities, and risk prevention systems. Facing the increasingly complex financial market environment, traditional risk management and early warning methods are becoming more and more passive and backward, unable to meet the real-time and dynamic monitoring and early warning of risk information, and cannot meet the efficiency requirements of financial business management in the era of big data. Traditional risk management methods are relatively advanced in terms of timeliness and business guidance of risk early warning management and have become a bottleneck. This article uses big data technology to realize the integration of internal and external data of financial institutions, builds a high-performance big data collection, storage, and analysis platform, efficiently integrates various types of information and data and applies them to risk control, and enhances the intelligence and automation of risk management and control. level. The results show that the financial risk prediction model of the platform is effective.

articleTitle: COVID-19 Classification using CT Scan Images with Resize-MobileNet
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Coronavirus disease 2019 broke out in early 2020 and quickly spread to over 200 countries, leading to a severe health crisis for people all over the world. In high-risk areas of the epidemic, the shortage of testing reagents and medical facilities have become essential factors restricting the treatment of COVID-19 patients. Computed tomography (CT) has helped doctors make medical diagnoses in many areas as a vital technology in medical field. At present, due to personal privacy issues, it isn't easy to compare different networks because they are all conducted on different data sets, using other metrics, and can not make good use of high-resolution CT images. Based on iCTCF's public data set, 4000 photos from 61 patients are used to propose a network of high-resolution inputs for diagnosing disease using lung CT images of COVID-19 patients. Our work makes better results than traditional image classification methods in limited data sets, contributing to the advancement of deep neural networks in the field of COVID-19CT image recognition.

articleTitle: An analysis of multimodal emotional braincomputer interface
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Emotional brain computer interface is a branch of emotional intelligence, which can be divided into emotional recognition brain computer interface and emotional regulation brain computer interface. At present, the main research direction of emotional brain computer interface is to accurately identify emotions and realize human-computer interaction. Because physiological signals can more intuitively and accurately express people’s real emotional state, researchers often use the features extracted from EEG to train emotion recognition classifier. However, recent studies have shown that single-mode signals alone can not comprehensively and objectively evaluate emotions, while multi-mode signals have good complementary characteristics, which can improve the classification accuracy. In practical application, the impact of defects of single signals on classification results can be reduced by adjusting weight parameters, Therefore, multimodal brain computer interface has gradually become one of the hot research directions of emotional intelligence. The difficulty of multimodal brain computer interface is how to select the correct fusion method to improve the performance of emotion recognition. The decision level fusion method is widely used in the research. The research of emotion recognition has very important theoretical and practical significance, and plays an irreplaceable role in human-computer interaction system. This paper describes emotion recognition, fusion methods, research results and application prospects around multimodal brain computer interface.

articleTitle: Smart Classification System of Solid Wood Board Based on Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Solid wood board classification is the most important detection process in the production of solid wood integrated materials. At present, most of the detection links still use artificial methods. In this paper, the network model of CSPDarkNet is lightweight and introduced into the efficient channel attention (ECA) mechanism, the ECA-CSPDarkNet algorithm model is built. It is used for the preferred classification of the solid wood board, which can improve the automation of the production process of solid wood integrated materials, reduce the labor of workers and reduce waste of wood. According to the actual needs of solid wood plate classification, we collect 9 kinds of surface feature images of solid wood boards to construct a data set of 9,000 images. Using the proposed ECA-CSPDarkNet model to train, test, and compare with the detection accuracy and detection speed of other convolutional neural networks models. Finally, the average detection accuracy of 9 kinds of samples reached 98.44%, and the detection speed reached 5. 88ms/sheet.

articleTitle: Design of Detection and Measurement System for Petroleum Transportation Pipeline Based on WEB Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: With the rapid development in speed and quality of the economy in China, petroleum energy, as one of the main energy sources in today’s human society, has increasingly demonstrated its status. At the same time, petroleum transportation as an important part of petroleum applications should invest more research efforts. With the development of the information age and the continuous update and iteration of intelligent technology, the traditional petroleum transportation management model can no longer meet the requirements of the current era. The technological innovation focusing on the measurement of petroleum transportation pipelines is poised for take-off which studies the application of Internet methods combining the advantages of the information age. Based on the analysis of previous research results, this paper takes the overall requirements of the petroleum transportation pipeline as the goal for demand analysis and updates the key technologies on this basis to establish a new WEB-based petroleum transportation pipeline detection and measurement system, which studies the frontier technology of big data processing and the automatic measurement and storage of petroleum pipeline data is realized by combining database system, Java technology and Web technology.

articleTitle: A Two-Dimensional InSAR Phase Unwrapping Method Based on Deep Convolutional Neural Network and L1 Norm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Synthetic Aperture Radar Interferometry (InSAR) is a technology that obtains three-dimensional information on the surface of the earth by calculating the phase difference of the interferometric complex image. Phase unwrapping plays a decisive role in the accuracy of digital elevation model. Estimating the true phase gradient is a key step in phase unwrapping. The traditional phase unwrapping algorithm depends on the continuity assumption to calculate the unwrapping phase gradient. However, due to the discontinuity caused by noise and terrain mutation, the unwrapping phase will have a large error. In this paper, a phase unwrapping method based on deep convolution neural network and L1 norm optimization is proposed. Firstly, the phase ambiguity gradient is calculated by feature pyramid and global attention network (FGANet), which is a lightweight network combining two attention mechanisms. Then, the neural network calculation results are corrected by L1 norm to obtain accurate phase ambiguity gradient data. Finally, the unwrapping phase data can be obtained by simple integration. By using the FGANet network to calculate the phase ambiguity gradient instead of the original phase continuity assumption, it has higher accuracy and robustness than traditional algorithms. Can quickly unwrap a wide range of wrapping phases.

articleTitle: NOCAQF: An Efficient Nonlinear Online Data Compression Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Industrial real-time data stream provides great potential in producing big data to support industrial system optimization and intelligent management decision-making. However, storingall massive industrial data without compression requires a huge storage space. Meanwhile,the online transmission consumes a lot of network bandwidth, which brings high pressure to the data transmission line. In practice, the real-time data collected by industry are not always variable and valuable, and contain many redundant data, which obviously affects the efficiency of big data analysis. How to efficiently compress the industrial real-time data, relieve the pressure of industrial real-time data transmission, reduce the storage overhead, and improve the analysis efficiency, is the key technical problem to be solved in industrial manufacturing. To address this problem, the industry has proposed a variety of data compression algorithms, such as revolving door compression algorithm, sliding window compression algorithm and Bayesian compression algorithm. However, there are still some issues such as low compression efficiency, large amount of computation, and poor compression effect. Aiming at the requirement of industrial real-time data compression, this work proposes a nonlinear on-line process data compression algorithm termed NOCAQF based on quadratic function. Simulation and comparative experiments show that the proposed algorithm has the advantages of simple parameters, high compression rate and small amount of computation. When the data collection system processes massive real-time concurrent data streams, NOCAQF can significantly reduce the system load and improve the comprehensive compression rate on the premise of small amount of computation.

articleTitle: High-definition Video Codec System Based on Camera Link Interface and Adjustable Bit Rate
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In order to meet the needs of wireless low-latency transmission of high-definition video for the mission load of unmanned ground vehicle (UGV), a set of high-definition video codec system (HD VCS) based on Camera Link interface and limited bit rate was designed. The HD VCS uses H.265 compression technology and limited bit rate to compress the same image to varying degrees and evaluate its quality separately. The Peak Signal to Noise Ratio (PSNR) in the full-reference objective evaluation is used to evaluate the error in the image compression and transmission process, and the structural similarity (SSIM) is used to evaluate the degree of restoration of the image, and they are correlated with the subjective evaluation score. Explore the relationship between bit rate and image quality, and then analyze the most suitable bit rate range in various application scenarios, and use it as the adjustable range of bit rate of the HD VCS to achieve a balance between image quality and transmission bandwidth.

articleTitle: Application of Computer Big Data Technology in the Safety Intelligent Monitoring of High Voltage Charging of Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The continuous development of new energy vehicles coincides with the concept of energy conservation and environmental protection. In order to improve the high-voltage safety of electric vehicles, the functions of the high-voltage safety monitoring system have been expanded in the computer big data technology environment. In the overall structure, the traditional high-voltage safety monitoring system for electric vehicles is integrated into the Internet of Vehicles to realize the interconnection and sharing of fault information; in terms of fault information communication means, short-range communication is also used to realize the communication between the vehicle and the vehicle, and between the vehicle and the road infrastructure. Fault information sharing, through remote communication to realize the fault information sharing between the car and the user, the car and the Internet; in the fault alarm mode, for the general fault of the high voltage safety of the electric vehicle, the driver will be prompted by the sound and light alarm and the LCD screen to prompt the driver of the fault type and Approach. The research results show that the high-voltage safety monitoring system in the computer big data technology environment is a seamless connection between the monitoring system and the Internet of Vehicles, which is beneficial to prevent safety accidents.

articleTitle: Risk assessment model of 10kV distribution line special transformer trip based on improved TOPSIS algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: As the final link of the power system, the distribution network can distribute electric energy to power users through distribution equipment. Therefore, it is urgent to evaluate the trip risk of feeder transformer users. Based on the improved TOPSIS algorithm, this paper proposes a user trip risk assessment method for special substations of 10kV distribution lines. First, six risk assessment indicators are extracted from the two dimensions of the environment and the transformer body, the quantitative indicators and the association rules of the user tripping of special transformers, and the feeders are used as the evaluation unit to fill in the indicators to form an evaluation sample. Secondly, combining the entropy method and the analytic hierarchy process to comprehensively weight the indicators, and use the weighted Mahalanobis distance to replace the traditional Euclidean distance to improve the TOPSIS algorithm, and build a 10kV distribution line dedicated substation user trip risk assessment model. Based on the above model, the sample risk assessment coefficient is calculated, and the risk level is divided according to the data distribution characteristics, and the sample risk assessment is completed. Finally, the user data of a 10kV distribution line dedicated to a certain urban power grid in southern China was used to verify the effectiveness of the risk assessment method.

articleTitle: Design of MSSTP-SA Net Hardware Accelerator Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Recently, neural network-based methods have achieved great success in many practical applications. However, applications based on these widely used neural networks, such as Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), have a great demand for computing resources. It is difficult to apply to embedded devices. As Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) is widely used as an acceleration platform for CNN, more and more network models begin to use FPGA for model deployment. This article uses a Multi-Step Spatial-Temporal Situational-Awareness Network (MSSTP-SA Net) used in the security field as a reference. Firstly, the model is analyzed in depth, and the inference part of the model is optimized according to the demand of inference calculation. The layer fusion method is used to fuse the inference calculation of the batch normalization layer and the convolutional layer of the model, which solves the problem that the batch normalization layer needs to consume extra multiplier resources in FPGA. Then, the convolutional layer of the model is analyzed, and a reasonable parallel scheme of the convolutional layer is designed. And use the method of pipeline to solve the problem of parallelism between layers. Based on the proposed parallel scheme, a dedicated AI accelerator for inference acceleration of the model was designed, and it was deployed on a programmable SOC hardware platform for testing. The results show that the accelerator designed by us only uses 200 multipliers, and it only takes 1.694ms to complete the spatial and time domain decoder inference calculations of the model, which takes less time than the Central Processing Unit(CPU) and Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) to complete the same calculation. And it is far superior to them in terms of performance-to-power ratio.

articleTitle: Fine operation intelligent analysis for adjustable power load resources
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The development service of adjustable load resource operation analysis module is a support platform deployed to adapt to the participation of adjustable load resources in regulation business. It is a part of smart grid dispatching control system (referred to as “D5000 system”) egion through it. It is mainly positioned as the load resource information gathering and processing center. The adjustable load resource operation analysis module carries out information undertaking, analysis and processing with the traditional automation system, realizes the on-demand interaction of monitoring, control and market data among various systems, and supports the adjustable load resources to participate in the regulation business without affecting the traditional business structure of the existing production control. It includes basic platform, data acquisition, processing verification, model data storage, auxiliary analysis and decision-making, instruction forwarding, control effect verification and visual display. The adjustable load resource operation analysis module service shall meet the cross platform interconnection and high time effective data exchange with the operation systems of different aggregators, so as to realize the comprehensive collection, monitoring, comprehensive analysis and display of adjustable load resources by dispatching. Establish a complete data model based on the characteristics of load resource objects, access the real-time measurement of load monomer and aggregation, AGC on / off signal, adjustable upper and lower limits and other control data, undertake the transfer and distribution of AGC instructions and planned values, and release market data such as declaration, clearing, settlement information and announcement. Meet the “comprehensive collection, reliable interaction and on-demand provision” of information between traditional dispatching automation system, aggregator operation platform, regulation cloud, auxiliary service market and other systems, and finally realize the panoramic perception, analysis and control of adjustable load operation situation on the dispatching side.

articleTitle: Abnormal data intelligent detection method based on combined machine learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In this paper, based on abnormal load data, the method of energy Internet load data detection and correction is proposed based on the chaotic directional cuckoo algorithm (COCS) to optimize the Elman-IOC prediction model. Firstly, the Elman-IOC model is trained through a large amount of load data, and the COCS optimization algorithm is selected to find the parameters of the prediction model, the parameter-tuned Elman-IOC model is used to load prediction. And then, starting from the results of load prediction, the abnormal load data in the load curve is detected by error analysis and outliers determination criteria, and the abnormal load data detected is corrected by applying the prediction results.

articleTitle: An Infrared and Visible Image Fusion Method Based on Adaptive Weight Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Aiming at the low utilization efficiency of depth features and insufficient restoration of fusion image texture information in existing fusion algorithm based on adversarial neural network, this paper proposed an infrared and visible image fusion technology based on adaptive weight Learning. Under the framework of the adversarial neural network, a deep feature adaptive extraction module based on pixel-level attention mechanism and fusion weight adaptive generation was designed to efficiently extract image features, and then effectively combine multiple depth features adaptive extraction modules through hierarchical cascade to further improve the ability of deep-level feature extraction and build a generator network. Then, a discriminator group based on a two-way neural network was constructed. Finally, the fusion image was completed through the game confrontation between the generator and the discriminator. The experimental results show that the fusion image generated by the proposed method can well restore the infrared characteristic information of the infrared band data and the detailed scene information in the visible light data, and has a strong ability to enhance the fusion of infrared and visible images.

articleTitle: The System Design of Avionics Coordinated Test Based on Dual-arm Cooperative Robot
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The introduction of collaborative robots in aircraft cockpit for autonomous maintenance of avionics can improve labor efficiency and reduce the probability of human error and other quality problems. This paper designs a set of avionics joint test system for aircraft cockpit based on dual-arm cooperative robot. The system includes physical simulation of aircraft cockpit, installation and positioning of dual-arm robot, end-effector, joint test perception, image processing and human-computer interaction system. The robot can automatically calibrate the position of the robot and avionics equipment through machine vision. The robot can carry out automatic detection of avionics equipment according to the pre-set detection program, and can compare the detection with the display information of the corresponding instrument in real time to confirm its correctness. The system can save the result data of all detection in the server database, and carry out data analysis and mining to optimize the detection operation method.

articleTitle: Design and Research on Test System of AC and DC Charging Pile for Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Design and research electric vehicle AC and DC charging pile test system, develop charging pile test system user interface, and complete automatic charging pile test. The AC and DC charging pile test system is composed of programmable controls to complete the detection of various parameters of the charging pile. Design sample maintenance, program maintenance, sample inspection and other multi-interface systems, the system will be tested according to pre-set procedures to realize fully automatic testing. The electric vehicle AC and DC charging pile test system reduces the inspection time and improves the test and inspection efficiency.

articleTitle: Design of Ship True Wind Measurement System Based on RT-Thread
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the existing volunteer ship true wind measurement is not accurate enough, this paper studies the ship motion compensation technology and the ship true wind measurement method, and proposes a ship true wind measurement technology based on RT-Thread. A measurement system is built with STM32 single chip microcomputer as the main control core, RT-Thread operating system as the basis, supplemented by various acquisition sensors, The hardware and software of the measurement system are introduced in detail. Combined with the five indexes of wind direction, wind speed, bow direction, speed and heading, the compensation of ship motion is realized, the influence of ship rolling, pitch and other motions is eliminated, and the true wind value is obtained to help users master the true wind data of the ship in time.

articleTitle: Research on Path Planning Algorithm Method in Parking Lot Based on Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: With the rapid popularity of private cars, the pressure on the urban transportation system is increasing. At the same time, the lack of parking spaces has caused difficulties in parking and finding parking spaces. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes to use in the parking lot. A path planning method based on the Internet of Things technology. This method uses Internet of Things equipment to collect parking data in a parking lot, and uses an ant colony algorithm to implement path planning and route distribution based on the parking data. On the one hand, the method can improve the operating efficiency in the parking lot and save the operating cost in the parking lot. On the other hand, it can also realize the reverse car search, which is convenient for users to use.

articleTitle: Study on Loose Failure Diagnosis of High–voltage Parallel Electric Reactor Based on SDICA BSS Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The vibration test signal of a high voltage parallel reactor of Shandong electrician is separated using the SDICA blind source separation algorithm(BSS). Only the 100Hz frequency component, consistent with the reactor vibration signal and 100Hz as the main frequency, but includes harmonic component including 200Hz, 300Hz, 400Hz, 500Hz and direct test results, which directly reflects the core vibration change due to loosening and effectively separates the abnormal core vibration signal.

articleTitle: Distribution Side Optimal Operation and Control of Coupled FCS and BESS
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: With the rapid development of electric vehicle industry, electric vehicle (EV) charging has posed a great challenge to the dispatching operation of power system. In this paper, the problem caused by the unpredictable charging behavior of electrical vehicles are studied. In order to compensate the effect brought by EV charging behavior, a method is proposed in this paper, which can minimize the cost of EV fast charging station (FCS) and in the meantime, it can ensure the safe operation of distribution system. Last, the model is tested and verified on a real world distribution system topology using data from a real world FCS.

articleTitle: Data anomaly intelligent detection based on machine learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In order to distinguish whether it is abnormality with risk or without risk when environmental data collected by the device sensor is abnormal, this paper adpots k-means algorithm and hierarchical clustering algorithm in machine learning respectively to divide it, and compares the two algorithms on this research. The clustering results show that the risk-free abnormal data has the character of regularity, independence and contingency. The abnormal data with risk has the character of continuity and linkage.

articleTitle: Inverse Diffraction Parabolic Equation Model Based on Finite Difference Method for Passive Location on Irregular Terrain
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The paper presents an inverse diffraction parabolic equation (IDPE) radio propagation model to implement the precise radiation source positioning for irregular terrain. The IDPE model is efficient solved by the finite difference method (FDM). It is a kind of passive localization technique based forward electromagnetic waves (EWs) propagation. The conventional IDPE model is solved by the split-step Fourier transform (SSFT) method, which has wider grid space and be not suitable for irregular terrain. So its location precision is low. Here, the IDPE based on FDM has higher accuracy than SSFT, which suitable to solve radio propagation problems in complicated surface environment. The local extreme search method is used to quickly find the convergence points of electric field intensity in a certain domain. It can automatically detect and locate one or more the emitter source in complicated environment. The results of IDPE model are compared with those of ARPS, and good agreement is observed. The paper provides a new and convenient technique for passive location of multiple targets in large-scale irregular terrain environment.

articleTitle: An intelligent loss reduction method for distribution network based on intelligent optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The intelligent distribution network can be based on the idea of “source-network-1oad” coordinated optimization for intelligent loss reduction. By analyzing the characteristics of each part of the distribution network separately, the corresponding mathematical models are established. This paper proposes an intelligent loss reduction method for distribution network based on intelligent optimization algorithm with the goal of reducing network loss. The proposed method is analyzed by using IEEE-33 node network and the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified.

articleTitle: Parameter symmetry analysis of four circuit transmission lines on the same tower
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Taking the parameter symmetry of four circuit transmission lines on the same tower as the core, this paper intends to carry out research work from the aspects of parameter calculation method and parameter symmetry of four circuit transmission lines on the same tower.Firstly, the calculation method of the original parameters of the transmission line and the unbalance degree of the transmission line are introduced, and then the action law of a large number of factors on the parameter symmetry of the four circuit transmission line on the same tower is studied by using PSCAD simulation software. Finally, it is concluded that the phase sequence arrangement of the transmission line, the number of lightning conductors, phase to phase distance and other factors will affect it,It also puts forward measures to improve the parameter symmetry of multi circuit transmission lines on the same tower, so as to improve the power quality and provide guidance for ensuring the operation safety of erected EHV / UHV transmission lines and the application of multi circuit transmission lines on the same tower.

Author Keywords: four circuits in the same tower

articleTitle: Application of 74LS Series Chips
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Electronic lock is often seen in daily life, the main content of this design is to design an eight-bit binary number password lock. When the password is entered correctly, the electronic lock is opened and the door bell rings. When the password is entered incorrectly, the alarm system rings.

articleTitle: Sag characteristics analysis of an ACSR300/25 conductor under temperature changes
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Transmission lines are prone to strand breakage in the face of freezing disasters, and short-circuit problems can also occur due to changes in sag. How to make the ACSR can operate normally in an environment with large temperature changes and complex terrain is an urgent problem to be solved at this stage. This paper studies the influence of temperature on the elastic modulus of the wire, establishes an analysis model of the wire sag, applies a temperature load on the model and changes the elastic modulus, and calculates the variation of the wire sag. The change of the sag of the conductor after power-on is studied. In this paper, the influence of temperature on conductor’s elastic modulus is studied, and an analysis model of conductor’s sag is established. The variation of conductor’s sag is calculated by applying temperature load and changing elastic modulus on the model. The change of conductor sag after electrification was studied. The results show that under the influence of the coefficient of linear expansion and elastic modulus, the change of wire temperature makes the wire sag change greatly. Compared with the sag at normal temperature, the increase rate of wire sag at high temperature is 20%. The increase in wire sag due to the change in elastic modulus accounts for 5% of the total increase. Considering the change of elastic modulus, the calculation of sag cannot be ignored.

articleTitle: IoT Data Acquisition Terminal Based on Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In recent years, smart home technology has gained broader user acceptance. Besides contributing to private homes, these new technologies have the potential to complement classical public and commercial building automation. Based on Raspberry Pi and openHAB, this paper builds an intelligent gateway to solve the problems that most IoT devices in the market are heterogeneous and closed. The system can control light bulb remotely, support multiple protocols and support several functions such as weather, pushing email, etc. The test results and data analysis show that each function module of the system works normally.

articleTitle: Construction of high precision 3D campus real scene model based on UAV
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: With the advancement of smart city, digital twin and 3d china construction, the quality requirements of geographic information products for real 3D construction are getting higher and higher. Uav tilt photogrammetry, as one of the effective means of basic 3D data acquisition, can efficiently obtain multi-perspective image information of ground targets, and then achieve fast real 3D modeling. However, The real tilted 3D model is easily affected by the environmental conditions of uav aerial photography, which leads to the fuzzy deformation of building contour and surface texture. Moreover, the tilt model is a continuous TIN triangular mesh, so important buildings cannot be selected separately. Therefore, In this paper, using the method of model reconstruction of monomer, based on the tilt model, manual line to draw the outline of the outline of the building, the building automatic texture mapping, generated by the single building model, building texture can be controlled manual correction, details of the controllable, so the real 3 d model metope smooth, texture clear, the overall effect is better.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Deformation Strategy of FAST Active Reflector Based on Whole Network Node Control
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The active reflector is a crucial component of the 500-meter-aperture spherical radio telescope (FAST). The major issue for receiving celestial reflection signals quickly is how to change the active reflector from the reference sphere to the working paraboloid. For starters, because the sphere and paraboloid are both totally symmetrical structures, this transformation may be described as a transition from an arc to a parabola. The parabola family controlled by parameter h can be determined from analytical geometry based on the unique position of the feed cabin’s focus plane. Second, we create a model of the main cable node’s displacement decomposition. The node’s lateral deviation is decomposed into meridional and latitudinal displacement. A weighted complete examination of three indexes: radial displacement range, meridional displacement range, and latitudinal ring length change rate yields the best answer. The ideal paraboloid equation is then rotated around the y-axis and the z-axis progressively through rotation transformation, and the matrix expression of the transformation is obtained, in order to obtain the ideal paraboloid equation after rotation, according to the position of the celestial body. Finally, the fast main cable node control model based on PSO is constructed using the usual particle swarm optimization algorithm. To reach the global optimal solution, the distance difference between the ideal paraboloid and the working paraboloid is examined and iteratively optimized as the fitness function.

articleTitle: The Adversarial Attack on Domain Adaptation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Adversarial attack and defense have been a hot topic recently. The subtle perturbations that are not recognized by the human eye can fool models and lead to misclassification. While most recent works focus on the attack for image classification models, there is no systematic research on the adversarial attack for unsupervised domain adaption(UDA) models. We empirically investigate the resilience of UDA models to adversarial perturbations in this work. And we propose to attack the target domain so that the UDA models can correctly classify the source domain images but classify the target domain images wrong. This will make the adversarial examples more confusing to humans. Experiments show that the UDA models are vulnerable to adversarial examples under both white-box and black-box manners. We hope that this work will attract the increasing attention to the robustness of the UDA models.

articleTitle: Real-time miniaturized intelligent detection system for moisture content based on microwave transmission
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In the current production process, the moisture content of the tobacco leaves directly affects the quality of the final products. In response to the lack of moisture content monitor for stored tobacco leaves in the domestic and foreign market, combined with the microwave technology, the paper proposes a miniaturized and real-time tobacco moisture content monitor design. The system selects the AWR1642 radio frequency chip as the radio frequency part and the main processor and offsets the loss of propagation between different media by the design of one transmit and two receive antennas. And it uses the LoRa interface to achieve wireless transmission so that it can realize the visualization of data on the cloud server.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Evaluation Model of Service Quality of Plateau Train Station Using Big Data Calculation and SEM Model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: With the development of plateau cities, high plateau trains are taking on more and more passenger transportation tasks. In order to improve the service quality of plateau train stations, combining the characteristics of passenger transportation at plateau train stations, the passenger service quality model for plateau train stations is constructed based on the structural equation model, and from the four aspects of hardware perfection, software perfection, service level and operational organization efficiency. The validity of the model is verified by taking Lhasa Station as an example. In addition, hardware perfection, software perfection, service level and operational organization efficiency all have a positive impact on plateau train stations, and suggestions are made for improving the passenger service level of plateau train stations.

articleTitle: Study on Smart Evaluation Index System and Information Digitization in the Road Organization Based on AHP-Entropy Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: To formulate a scientific and reasonable road organization plan in the course of the construction period of roads in Lhasa city, the current traffic organization scheme during construction period is firstly evaluated and studied by combining AHP and entropy method. Secondly, the evaluation index system for the traffic organization scheme of the construction section is constructed from the three aspects of the regional road network, traffic facilities and driving, and road intersections. Finally, based on the analysis results, some feasible measures are proposed for the current transportation organization scheme of Najin Township during the construction period.

articleTitle: Design of temperature acquisition circuit in electrical measurement
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: This design is to design a temperature acquisition circuit, according to the temperature change, the circuit output 4-20mA current, to represent the value of the temperature at this time.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Urban Rail Transit Train Passenger Flow Intelligent Monitoring System Based on CNN
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Train video monitoring system for Urban rail transit provides safety guarantee for passengers. By analyzing the development needs of video monitoring system, this paper designs the overall architecture of train passenger flow monitoring system. Through comparing the implementation schemes of different convolutional neural networks (CNN) in passenger flow monitoring and analyzing the value of train passenger flow data and its application scenarios, the feasibility and necessity of studying passenger flow monitoring system are clarified.

articleTitle: An autonomous driving advisor: analysis of driving behavior character based on dislocation feature combination
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Imitating the highly skilled drivers’ operation can significantly improve the performance of autonomous driving. However, it is difficult to distinguish between the skilled and unskilled drivers, because the good driving skill is the cooperation of series different operations on not only along velocity direction but on the vertical velocity direction. At present, the main analysis algorithms that distinguish between skilled and unskilled drivers are focused on a single driving operation, which cannot fully reflect the driving behavior of the driver. Therefore, we researched the differences in coordination among multiple driving operations, like the cooperation of speed and steering, for skilled and unskilled drivers in this paper. Firstly, we built a simulation platform to collect large numbers of driving data. Secondly, a candidate feature generating method was proposed, by which, two or more different driving operations with time delay were combined into a candidate combined feature. The method was named dislocation feature combination because different driving operations are combined at the dislocation sites. Finally, we proposed a combination feature extractor based on Adaboost for its interpretability, which selects critical combined features to distinguish between skilled drivers and unskilled drivers. A series of experiments were carried out using driving data collected from simulated driving platforms, especially focusing on the drivers’ operation difference at each curve. The results show that it is feasible to analyze driving behavior by using AdaBoost and combined feature

articleTitle: Universal Watermark Attack in Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Recent researches have shown it is possible to fool a deep neural network classifier by adding watermark perturbations. The watermark can be used to protect copyright and has practical meaning, but currently, there is no method that can generate universal watermark perturbation. The main reason is that the fooling rate is no differentiable for the perturbations. In this paper, we adopt the loss function trick and mask function trick to generate universal watermark perturbation then evaluate its fooling rate with different watermark shapes, locations, numbers and deep neural network architectures. The results show the universal watermark perturbations achieve good performance and can be successfully used to generate universal watermark adversarial examples.

articleTitle: Construction and Optimization of Closed Loop Supply Chain System for Construction Engineering Based on Ant Colony
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: At present, the construction engineering contracting in the international market generally adopts the construction engineering general contracting (EPC) mode. With the expansion of construction engineering projects, the competition among EPC contractors is intensified, resulting in a series of supply chain problems. At present, China’s construction engineering contracting is at a disadvantage in the international competition mainly due to the lack of its own supply chain structure and model, and supply chain is at the core of the general contracting of construction engineering. Based on the above background, this article designed the construction engineering supply chain system, completed the construction engineering supply chain system through the design of procurement module and supply chain management module, on this basis, the internal structure and external structure of the supply chain were preliminarily optimized. The external structure is optimized in sampling radius design, supplier selection index and relative weight optimization, single index visualization optimization, supply structure and supply attribute evaluation optimization. The supply and demand relationship structure optimization for the inner loop supply chain system, and the optimization for procurement demand forecasting model. On the basis of this, the author of this article constructs the model of random demand for logistics recovery path of closed-loop supply chain system of construction projects, on this basis, design the optimize by hybrid ant colony algorithm, and the supply chain optimization algorithm simulation with soft time window is designed for the above algorithm. The simulation results show that the supply chain model construction and algorithm have an optimization effect on the closed-loop supply chain system.

articleTitle: Design and Application on Multi-levels of Collaborative Management System for Business Middle Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In order to improve the ability of business collaboration and management between multi-level units of large enterprises, this paper designs a two-level application collaborative architecture based on the current popular technical architecture of container, and puts forward a method of collaborative computing for distributed management. The distributed nodes of container cloud are built from runtime environment of wide areas. It can pull docker images from image library in management center. It realizes visualization of algorithm and application. At the same time, it can construct and deploy remote application release independently. And then it uses calculation resources and data services provided by the enterprise middle platform to carry out integrated business analysis and application. Finally, it introduces the application of A Map of Power Grid as a case in SGCC, shows the research findings and value.

articleTitle: Design of Temperature and Humidity Measurement System Based on Single Chip Microcomputer
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In this paper, the temperature and humidity measurement system is designed based on single chip microcomputer, and the temperature and humidity data are collected by DHT11 temperature and humidity sensor. The software system design part uses C language to establish a detailed design flow chart, which can realize data collection, temperature and humidity upper and lower limits setting, alarm display, compensation temperature and humidity and display. Finally, the simulation analysis is carried out by Proteus software to verify the rationality of the design.

articleTitle: Design of YUMI Collaborative Robot Sorting System Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: With the wide application of artificial intelligence, automation and intelligence provide strong technical support for industrialization and informanization for automatic production line. Traditionally, electrical control or sensor fusion technology are used for automatic sorting production line, which has the disadvantages such as complicated technical route and difficult maintenance. This study uses flexible ABB YUMI cooperative robot as the carrier, based on the Halcon machine vision recognition algorithm platform. Our study mainly focuses on real-time collection of workpieces, digital image processing, result output, and communication with the robot to achieve workpiece sorting. The system model created and its kinematic parameters defined in Matlab simulation platform, we confirmed the feasibility of mechanical system, visual system, and robot control system design, and verified sorting effect of the workpiece in different colors and shapes. Our study provides important support for the design of multi-DOF robot machine vision sorting system.

articleTitle: Risk Information Fusion Method for Consumer Product Quality Safety Based on Triangular Fuzzy Number
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
