abstract: In view of the diverse sources, complex structure and other features of the risk information of consumer product quality safety, as well as the difficulty in the fusion of such information, this paper presents the information fusion method based on triangular fuzzy number and weighted averaging operator, and provides case verification. The results show that this method has good feasibility and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis of wave sensor based on wavelet packet and improved RBF neural network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: This paper presents a method to diagnose faults of wave sensor. Firstly, the simulated fault signal of wave sensors is decomposed by wavelet packet, then the feature vector of the fault signal is constructed, the feature vector is inputted into the improved RBF neural network. The improve RBF neural network adopts a mean shift algorithm to solve the problem of exactly determining the center vector of a traditional RBF neural network. Finally the results are visualized by t-sne dimensionality reduction method. Experiments show that this method can effectively determine the center vector of RBF neural network, and the accuracy of fault type recognition can be boosted.

articleTitle: Construction of power user label smart system based on unsupervised learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Mining value customers and providing high-quality services are the necessary ways for the transformation and upgrading of power grid enterprises. Combined with the characteristics of power big data and user groups, this paper constructs a complete set of power user label system from the four perspectives of basic attributes, internal demands, behavior mode and customer value. On this basis, an improved power user label system based on unsupervised learning is proposed, which helps to optimize the customer segmentation method, so as to facilitate power grid enterprises to accurately extract valuable key customers, realize differentiated marketing schemes and improve the competitiveness of enterprises.

articleTitle: Design of Information Security Model in Multimedia Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: This paper mainly describes the idea of creating massive data integration model. Because the Multimedia Network is a large-scale network system with the characteristics of wide range and wide coverage, when the Multimedia Network is operated and maintained, the network management will produce a lot of data. Therefore, the security intrusion detection equipment that needs to be deployed can collect the monitoring data of the whole network, which requires the ability to collect monitoring data from hundreds of deployed intrusion detection devices, so as to realize the monitoring ability of network attacks. The design goal of this paper is to comprehensively monitor the information security status of the whole network, find out the security anomalies in time, and make rapid diagnosis, so as to ensure the safe and stable operation of the whole network. Therefore, the risk analysis, assessment and audit model of massive data integration technology are needed to support the consolidation and classification of collected data. After the network problems are found, they can be reported to the Multimedia Network operation and maintenance department, and the basic information of relevant responsible units can be extracted in real time.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Low-quality Article Review System Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In the era of information Internet, We Media is becoming increasingly mature, and users’ demand for We Media information is also increasing, promoting the rapid development of diversified We Media platforms. We Media platforms gradually expand from the simple release of news consulting content to life, entertainment, social commentary, finance and economics and other aspects of content. Compared with traditional media platforms, We Media is more flexible and independent and relatively free in speech. Therefore, the quality of articles in “We media” is on various level. If it is not screened, it is likely to cause the wrong direction of public opinion. However, the traditional manual review method has the disadvantages of low efficiency, high cost of human resources, error-prone, and no guarantee of timeliness. Therefore, the adoption of machine review is the key method to solve the above problems. In this paper, a low-quality article review system based on deep learning is designed to improve the reading environment by automatically reviewing politically sensitive, vulgar pornography, and advertising and marketing content.

articleTitle: Research on identification method of stealing electricity based on data analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: With the acceleration of urbanization, the number of low-voltage users continues to grow, that brings a greater challenge to the anti-stealing electricity work. Aiming at the problem of insufficient efficiency in the detection of stealing electricity of low voltage users of urban power grid, a method of stealing electricity detection is proposed. Based on the analysis of line loss and power consumption data, and combined with the character and laws of stealing electricity, a correlation search model and heuristic search recognition model are established to detect the suspected stealing electricity user, and then the users are verified by sliding window checking method. The practice shows that this method can effectively detect stealing electricity behavior of low voltage users, which can greatly reduce the search scope of stealing electricity user and reduce line loss to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Method for Determining Power System High Fragile Target Sequence Based on Community Structure
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: With the acceleration of the construction of smart grids, the continuous advancement of computing technology, communication technology and intelligent control technology, the supporting role of the information network to the traditional power grid has been strengthened day by day, and the traditional power system has been transformed into a power cyber-physical system (CPS) with real-time perception, dynamic control and information services. In the context of the deep integration of cyber physics, the spread of cyber-attacks is gradually expanding, which will not only destroy the control functions of the information system, but may also trigger the butterfly effect and threaten the stable operation of the physical system. In order to effectively protect the high fragility target sequence and grasp the damage degree of the power CPS network attack, a method for determining the high fragility target sequence based on the community structure is proposed. First, select the community center node, the global center node, and the edge nodes connecting important communities to form the initial target node set according to the division of information network communities, then combine the node shrinkage theory and node propagation ability to evaluate the vulnerabilities of target nodes and rank them, and finally the non-negative influence gain is used as the criterion to determine the high fragility target sequence of the cyber-attack.

articleTitle: Computer Assisted Design of Motor and Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Transformer is a very important electrical equipment, carrying a variety of functions such as voltage conversion, current conversion and voltage regulation. This design is mainly to design a transformer circuit, complete 220V ac into 5V direct current function. The designed circuit was tested based on Mulitism simulation software.

articleTitle: Target Posture Estimation in Synthetic Aperture Radar Images via Attributed Scattering Centers Matching
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Target posture estimation is important part in synthetic aperture radar automatic target recognition. In this paper, we proposed a target posture estimation method based on attributed scattering centers matching. Attributed scattering center model perform well in target scattering field description, first, we use attributed scattering center model to predict the strong attributed scattering centers of the target, then approximate maximum likelihood algorithm is hired to extract strong scattering centers from test image and estimate its parameters. A similarity measurement algorithm is designed to evaluate the similarity between model-predicted scattering center set and test image extracted scattering center set. After finding the one-to-one correspondence with highest similarity between two scattering center set, linear regression is hired to estimated posture angle difference between model-predicted image and test image, and target posture angle estimation is updated based on the images posture difference. The accuracy and effectiveness of the proposed method are demonstrated based on experiments using simulated SAR data.

articleTitle: Insulation Fault Detection and Optimization System of High Voltage XLPE Cable Sheath
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In order to monitor the insulation fault of high voltage XLPE cable sheath and optimize it scientifically, a novel XLPE cable sheath insulation fault detection and optimization system based on difference frequency method is designed in this paper. The system mainly monitors and analyzes the insulation aging caused by water branches in XLPE power cables, and obtains the final detection results through simulation experiments. The results demonstrate that the system can accurately and continuously monitor the insulation fault of high voltage XLPE cable sheath, and scientifically optimize it, so as to make XLPE power cable provide the basis and premise for the safety and stability of power system.

articleTitle: Polarimetric dehazing utilizing Vis-NIR spectral image fusion
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Polarimetric dehazing methods have good ability in restoring images contaminated by haze. But noise and color distortion come along with the dehazing process, and those methods lack the ability to recover targets of long-distance. Our previous study has shown that the penetration ability of light is related with wavelength, light of long wavelength, especially in the infrared band, receives less attenuation from haze. Based on that fact, we decompose the dehazing process into 16 different spectral bands to achieve the optimized dehazing performance. An infrared band is added to enhance the dehazing performance in short-wavelength channels, thus increases the range of visibility and corrects the color distortion. The dehazed image is reconstructed through image fusion of the dehazed bands. Experimental analyses reveal enhanced details and reduced noise of dehazed images. Particularly, our method works well in retaining the color information of haze contaminated images. The amount of blueshift can be reduced by 71% at least.

articleTitle: Research on Lossless Compression of Hyperspectral Images Based on Improved Deep Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In order to improve the detection and recognition ability of multiscale hyperspectral images with weak edges, a lossless compression algorithm of multiscale hyperspectral images with weak edges based on improved deep learning is proposed. Using deep-level feature information extraction method to extract fine-grained features of cancer cells from multiscale hyperspectral images with weak edges, constructing 3D surface structure reconstruction model of multiscale hyperspectral images with weak edges, combining with variational Bayesian filter detection method to decompose multiscale color structure features of multiscale hyperspectral images with weak edges, and constructing gradually refined output structure model of multiscale hyperspectral images with weak edges, Fuzzy image coarse-scale neural network learning method is used to realize block matching and edge detection of multi-scale hyperspectral images with weak edges. Ultra-fine-grained features of multi-scale hyperspectral images with weak edges are extracted. Deep learning algorithm is used to adaptively optimize the lossless compression process of multi-scale hyperspectral images with weak edges, and the optimal design of lossless compression algorithm for multi-scale hyperspectral images with weak edges is realized. The simulation results show that the adaptive convergence of lossless compression of multi-scale weak edge hyperspectral images with this method is good, the feature resolution is strong, and the hyperspectral feature detection and recognition ability is good.

articleTitle: MWLS: median-weighted least squares algorithm for in-door localization in LOS environment
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The weighted least squares (WLS) algorithm is widely used in localizing under indoor environment due to its advantage of simple calculation. However, its accuracy is not well because it is sensitive to noise and it ignored the effect of observations. Therefore, this paper proposes a median weighted least squares algorithm (MWLS), which combines median observations (MO) and a new weighted matrix, namely, the expectation of the difference between each observation and MO to improve positioning performance. The simulation results show that the MWLS algorithm is superior to WLS in both accuracy and stability.

articleTitle: Prediction of Ecotourism Population Based on Exponential Smoothing and ARIMA Mixed Model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: While material and spiritual wealth is greatly en-riched, a series of existential crises such as resource, environmental and ecological problems have awakened human environmental awareness, and the green movement and green consumption have swept the world. Thus, ecotourism has also become a hot topic in academia and industry, attracting the attention of many scholars. In this paper, we will propose a hybrid model based on Exponential smoothing and ARIMA, and use the ARIMA model with the proposed model to predict the number of tourists and the total amount of tourism consumption in Guangxi. Finally, the performance of each model will be evaluated using regression predictors such as ME, RSME, and MAE. Through the results of this paper, we will make our suggestions for the future development of eco-tourism in Guangxi and further promote the healthy development of eco-tourism in Guangxi.

articleTitle: Design of a “Roadrunner” Mast-Type Robot Arm Based on a Small UAV
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Aiming at the limited loading capacity of small UAVs, a design of a mast-like manipulator imitating a “roadrunner” was proposed in this research. Designed in accordance with the bionic principle, it relies on the flexible and slender “neck” to perform effective reconnaissance when maneuvering on the ground and in the air, realizing high detection on the ground and looking down in the air. This paper completes the overall structure design of the manipulator based on the main technical indicators, using the D-H method to establish the pose matrix of the manipulator, and MATLAB programming to solve the forward and inverse kinematics of the manipulatorand determine the joint angle and arm length parameters. The design of this robotic arm enables the UAV to make full use of ground objects without being trapped by ground objects. It can implement the “roadrunner tactics” with high concealment and rapid three-dimensional penetration, which provides a brand new method of reconnaissance and guided strike for special operations such as urban combat and anti-terrorism.

articleTitle: Research on architecture and smart contract of household intelligent power service platform based on blockchain
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Household intelligent power service (HIPS) is an interaction service between power grid companies and household users. Power grid companies release interactive electricity demand and response subsidy price through HIPS platform to attract users to participate in orderly electricity consumption, so as to reduce the peak debt ratio of power consumption in stations or improve the consumption rate of new energy. This paper proposes an architecture of HIPS platform based on the Consortium blockchain, and then designs smart contracts for three types of participants: power grid companies, load aggregators and users. Finally, the proposed smart contract is implemented.

articleTitle: Magnetic field simulation and no-load loss calculation of large three-phase five-column disassembled transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Due to the limitation of transportation conditions, the volume of the transformer cannot be increased indefinitely. Therefore, it is necessary to disintegrate the iron core for transportation. Due to structural changes, the magnetic field distribution of the transformer core may be disordered and the no-load loss is too large. This paper, based on the field-circuit coupled finite element, conducted the three-dimensional transient electromagnetic field simulation study on the no-load performance of a large-scale three-phase five-column disassembled transformer. The magnetic density, no-load current and no-load loss of the transformer iron core were calculated. The simulation results were consistent with the experiment, verifying the correctness of the simulation method.

articleTitle: Intelligent Speaker Recognition Algorithm Based on SE-Res2Net
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that it is difficult for traditional speaker recognition algorithms to extract features in text-independent and short-term speech, a speaker recognition algorithm based on SE-Res2Net is proposed. The recognition model of the algorithm is composed of a fully connected Res2Net module and a Squeeze-and-Excitation (SE) module of the Channel Attention Model. The hierarchical connection structure in the Res2Net module can increase the receptive fields of the model and integrate the information of different channels. SE module assigns higher weight to the significant voiceprint feature channels to improve the recognition ability of the model in text-independent scenes. Combined with the self-attention pooling mechanism, the model further emphasizes the characteristic information of voiceprint, so as to solve the problem of insufficient short-term speech information. The experimental results in conventional and truncated data sets show that the SE-Res2Net model outperforms the existing methods in text-independent speaker recognition tasks, and also has the state-of-art performance in short-term speech recognition scenarios.

articleTitle: Travel demand forecast of a new high-speed railway station during COVID 19
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Passenger flow at a new high-speed railway station presents significant uncertainty during COVID-19, which brings a huge challenge to the daily management and operation of the station. To detect the future development trend of demand and reduce the impact of its fluctuation on the daily operation of the station, three classical forecast methods are applied to predict the passenger flow in and out of the station during workdays in this paper. Furthermore, the performance of these methods is compared by conducting a case study of Huairou South Station. The results show that the ARIMA model (autoregressive integrated moving average model) shows better performance than the neural network model and Bass model (Bass diffusion model). Finally, a revised ARIMA model is introduced to predict the passenger flow of the National Day.

articleTitle: Blind Synchronization Method of OFDM Sampling Clock Timing Based on Phase Difference
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Aiming at the timing deviation of the sampling clock in the blind synchronization process of the OFDM system, the impact of the sampling timing deviation on the blind demodulation of signal was first analyzed. For the shortcomings of the existing blind synchronization methods, combined with the characteristics of MPSK modulation, a sampling timing blind synchronization algorithm based on phase difference was proposed. The algorithm adopted the phase difference of the demodulated signal, considering the characteristic that the differenced signal is composed of main component and subcomponent, used the main component to identify the signal modulation type, and realized the separation of the two. Based on this, sub-components were used to perform blind estimation and blind synchronization on the sampling timing deviation. The simulation results show that, compared with the traditional blind equalization algorithm, this algorithm does not require additional data assistance, has good estimation performance for OFDM signals based on MPSK modulation, and reduced the calculation burden at the same time.

articleTitle: A DDoS attack detection method based on time series and random forest in SDN
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Since the decision and forwarding function are not coupled together in SDN, the network service configuration and deployment of SDN are more flexible than traditional networks. However, a DDoS attack can consume a lot of resources of controller, thereby paralyzing the entire network service. To solve this problem, a DDoS attack detection method based on time series and random forest (RF) in SDN is proposed. The detection method first uses the ARIMA model to predict the current flow information based on the historical information entropy. If the predicted value differs significantly from the actual situation, the detailed traffic features are further extracted. Finally, the RF algorithm is used to detect whether the SDN is attacked by DDoS. Experimental results show that this detection method has better detection performance than SVM, XGBoost, RF, and KNN algorithms.

articleTitle: A Self-Feedback Malware Detecting System based on HTTP Traffic
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: As one of the major threats to the Internet, malware has many variants and is difficult to detect. This paper proposes a HTTP traffic based self-feedback malware detecting system, aiming to overcome the weakness of traditional detection methods in terms of detection range, work efficiency, accuracy and adaptability to environmental changes. We first capture and analyze HTTP traffic by a selected time window. Then, we pre-process the captured traffic into streams. WebGraphic request algorithm is used to remove HTTP traffic generating by Web browsers. In order to avoid repeated processing of data, a fingerprint detection algorithm is used to identify similar traffic. We apply a deep learning algorithm to automatically extract features. Transfer learning and feedback learning strategy are also implemented to improve the detection effect, enabling the model to adapt to the changing network environment. We use the real-world dataset from campus traffic and experiments show that this system can efficiently and effectively detect malwares. In addition, the clustering of streams based on IP field and User-Agent field makes the granularity of malware object finer, which helps making the locating and tracing of malwares in Application level instead of IP level possible.

articleTitle: Multi-source data sharing of electrical equipment based on handle system identity resolution technology for Internet of things in electric industry
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In order to overcome the barriers of data sharing in the electric power industry, enhance the whole life cycle management level of power equipment, Handle identity resolution is used. This article introduces the application of data sharing of Handle identity resolution in electric systems. Through the application of handle identity resolution technology, the electrical equipment research and development process data, on-site operation data and all kinds of piecemeal data are to be integrate and apply. Power equipment production enterprises understand the production process quickly and accurately, monitory product health in real-time, handle problem products timely, grasp the upstream and downstream operations of electrical products at all levels, reduce enterprise logistics costs, master the real-time process of products, quickly freeze and recall problematic products, improve product quality, improve market credibility and competitiveness. Electric enterprises can grasp the electric power operation situation in a timely manner, reduce production costs and improve production efficiency. It strengthens the management of the whole life cycle of electrical equipment of power enterprises and power equipment manufacturers.

articleTitle: A Study of Autonomous Landing of UAV for Mobile Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Robot cooperation is the key to search and rescue (SAR) missions, which usually occur in complex situations affected by different types of disasters, and such situations usually require UAVs to cooperate with ground unmanned vehicles (UGVs) to provide valuable information, but achieving autonomous landing when return is urgently needed has been a research hotspot and difficulty in the field of mobile robotics. In this paper, an autonomous landing strategy for UAVs on mobile platforms is proposed to solve the above problems, and the specific research includes: (1) the construction of an autonomous landing platform and the design of cooperative target are completed considering the rapidity and stability of landing; (2) a method that can detect and track moving targets in real-time is proposed for the problem of moving target position movement; (3) the simulation scene and the actual scene of target identification is conducted accordingly. The experimental results show that the recognition of the target in both the simulation scene and the real scene is rapid and accurate.

articleTitle: Personalized Federated Learning System Based on Permissioned Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Federated learning ensures the privacy of data generated by large-scale IoT devices. Existing federated learning frameworks, based on centralized model coordinators, still face serious security challenges such as single point of failure and lack of privacy. In this paper, we propose a personalized federated learning system based on permissioned blockchain, which is divided into four layers of architecture are IoT device layer, network layer, edge computing layer, blockchain layer, and application layer, using permissioned blockchain as a federated learning server. And a permission blockchain-based personalized federation learning algorithm is proposed, which can achieve privacy protection and resistance to poisoning attacks with high accuracy. The experimental results revealed that the system has high privacy protection and anti-poisoning attack capability and can be deployed in edge computing situations.

articleTitle: Research in Traffic Accident Analysis Based on Multi-source Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The rapid economic development and the increase of car ownership have led to the rise of traffic accidents, and the means of measuring by tape measure, photographing and videotaping used in traffic accident processing can no longer adapt to the needs of rapid accident processing and cause analysis. In this paper, the scene data obtained by UAV and 3D laser scanner are fused to realize the digitization of the accident scene. Secondly, the fused scene point cloud data is used as the basis for accident reconstruction in PC-Crash to obtain accident process data and generate a 3D model of the accident scene at the same time. Finally, the accident scene and the accident process are reproduced in 3D in PreScan to analyze the causes of the accident and formulate corresponding accident prevention measures. The accident investigation and analysis method of multi-source data fusion proposed in this paper can provide some reference for accident investigation, accident analysis and accident prevention.

articleTitle: Interactive Energy Optimization for Integrated Energy Parks Based on Cooperative Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In the energy interaction mechanism of integrated energy parks, in order to minimize the total operating cost of each integrated energy park and improve the internal power sharing level of multi integrated energy parks at the same time, based on the cooperative game theory, an interactive energy optimization cooperative game model of multi integrated energy parks including wind power, PV power, gas turbines and energy storage devices is established. The paper proposes a method of benefit sharing for integrated energy parks interactive energy optimization cooperation alliance based on the method of Shapley value, nucleolus and bargaining. Combined with the numerical simulation of the interactive energy optimization model of integrated energy parks from the perspective of cooperative game, it is verified that the proposed cooperative theory method takes into account the maximization of the benefits of each economic entity in the system and improves the power sharing level among the members of integrated energy parks.

articleTitle: A Framework of Instructor Support System to Improve Learning Resource Development
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The fast development of information technology has changed the style of learning. Not only it can provide better learning experience to learners, it can also be beneficiary to instructors who prepare and develop the learning resources. An instructor support system has been proposed for this purpose. In order to monitor students’ performance and development of online learning resources on top of the functions provided by a general Learning Management System (LMS), this study proposed a web-based instructor support system. Data import, edit and feedback are well supported in the proposed system.

articleTitle: Research on longitudinal following control of intelligent fleet based on communication delay compensation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In order to proffer a solution for the problems associated with poor fleet control caused by communication delay, this study proposes a smart longitudinal following control solution, such as using a hierarchical longitudinal control structure which the upper control solves the controlled vehicle’s desired acceleration with the model prediction control algorithm, and the lower control provides the engine throttle opening angle based on the desired acceleration or achieves the acceleration/ braking of the controlled vehicle according to the braking pressure. Moreover, considering the systematic communication delay, the Kalman filter-based communication delay compensation algorithm is further proposed to compensate the vehicle state, and realize the stable tracking of the vehicle distance by providing vehicle state feedback for the model predictive control algorithm. Then, the corresponding control effect is verified through the CARSIM/SIMULINK joint simulation platform. The simulation test results showed that the proposed method which takes the communication delay into consideration can significantly improve the following performance of the intelligent fleet as well as improve its safety.

articleTitle: Joint Offloading and Energy Harvesting Design in Multiple Time Blocks for FDMA Based Wireless Powered MEC
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The combination of mobile edge computing (MEC) and wireless power transfer (WPT) has been identified as a viable technique for addressing the issue of mobile device battery capacity and processing capabilities. The job offloading from many mobile devices to the MEC server is achieved using the Frequency Division Multiple Access (FDMA) approach in this article. To answer the challenge of maximizing residual energy, we will investigate multi-user dynamic joint optimization of compute and wireless resource allocation over various time blocks. We use convex optimization technology and combine it with Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) conditions to turn the problem into a single-variable restricted convex optimization problem. Our joint optimization method outperforms other benchmark schemes for the residual energy maximization problem, according to numerical results. Furthermore, the approach can optimize residual energy while reducing computing complexity and increasing computation efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on the Quantity Evaluation of Speech Datasets for Model Training
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: With the maturity of intelligent speech technology and product application, the demand for high-quality speech datasets is increasing. There have been some researchers put effort on the quality evaluation of the structured data, but there are few standards appeared for the speech datasets. By analyzing the construction principle of speech algorithm model and analyzing the construction demand of speech datasets, a unified quality assessment framework for the speech datasets is presented. The framework proposes to evaluate the speech datasets in terms of four dimensions: breadth coverage, anthology distinction, professional field depth and data integrity. By proposing specific speech datasets quality evaluation metrics, calculation methods and evaluation steps, and analyzing the experimental examples and results of speech datasets quality evaluation in vehicle application field, this paper provides a reference basis for evaluating speech datasets quality and promoting datasets construction. Considering the diversified applicability, privacy issues, efficiency and automation requirements of speech datasets construction, some suggestions for the future development of high-quality speech datasets construction are put forward.

articleTitle: Feeder Switch Board Configuration and Cable Selection & Laying for the DC System within a 220kV Modula Substation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: With the promotion and application of modular smart substations by State Grid Corporation, the first clear requirements for DC system cascade fits in the new 18 countermeasures (2018 revised edition) and the upgrading of communication capabilities in substation construction in the text “State Grid Corporation Infrastructure Technology [2019] No. 51”, the DC power system feeder switch configuration has also changed. Moreover, with the implementation of the new version of fire protection standards for substations and the increasing emphasis on fire safety in substations, the selection as well as the laying of should also be studied in depth. Through the application of DC system configuration in the construction of a substation, reference advice is given on the configuration of DC system feeder switch and cable selection and laying in a 220kV modular substation.

Author Keywords: prefabricated cabin type secondary combined equipment

articleTitle: A Novel Transmitter Recognition Model with Fish-SVC Clustering Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Transmitter recognition with clustering method is an efficient spectrum sensing method to classify different devices and protect the spectrum space security. However, it is hard for the conventional clustering methods to recognize multiple transmitters in non-cooperative communication because some of the methods only process specific spectrum with narrowband. Besides, parameter setting and tuning strategies of the algorithms can be pretty challenging. We propose the recognition model with Fish-SVC clustering method to solve the problems above. We collect wideband spectrum trace data and extract reasonable statistical and physical features to conduct feature vectors of each signal. Our algorithm searches the optimal Gaussian kernel parameter and form reliable clusters. Therefore, we gather the signals that belong to the same transmitters together and recognize the devices. The experiment results show that Fish-SVC can recognize transmitters over wideband spectrum in a non-cooperative communication environment with a nearly 97% accuracy rate.

articleTitle: Research on the configuration method of smart distribution grid technology scheme based on target differentiation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Smart distribution grid can support the national ambitious goal of “carbon peak and carbon neutral” and the development strategy of building a new power system with new energy as the mainstay, and is also an important material basis for economic and social development. The application of smart distribution grid technology is an important technical means to realize the transformation of distribution grid intelligence. This paper constructs a smart distribution grid construction target system based on the demand of distribution grid intelligence enhancement, and proposes a method to develop a differentiated construction target set by combining the assessment of target importance and satisfaction. Further, taking into account multiple attributes such as technology development maturity, grid construction adaptability and application value of technologies, a combined evaluation method is used to score smart distribution network technologies comprehensively. Considering the goal-oriented variability and complexity of technology types, the optimal combination of technology solutions is the goal, and a mixed integer nonlinear programming model for the differentiated configuration of smart distribution network technology solutions is constructed. Finally, a certain distribution network construction scenario is used for analysis to verify the feasibility and validity of the model.
